content.title: Histopathology: Right Breast & Axillary Contents
content.rawText: Specimen: Right mastectomy specimen. Tumor size: 2.8 x 2.2 cm. Histology: Invasive Ductal Carcinoma, Nottingham Grade 2. Resection margins: All margins negative (>5mm). Axillary nodes: 1/14 positive for metastasis. IHC: ER positive (80%), PR positive (65%), HER2/neu: Negative (1+). Ki-67: 22%. Pathologic Stage: pT2 N1a M0.

sections.clinicalSummary: Invasive Ductal Carcinoma Grade 2 (pT2N1aM0). ER+/PR+, HER2 negative. 1/14 nodes involved.
